svg.font-family: Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How sprezzature-maps works
svg.desc: Flow diagram. At the top, a value per region, point events or a plate configuration feed two lanes. The left lane draws: it centres and projects on a real base map, classifies the values and names the method used, and draws one of three plates, returning an SVG with a scale bar in two units. The right lane audits: six static rules read the rendered plate back and ask whether it names its classification, carries its scale and credits its sources. Both meet in one outcome, a plate a reader can argue with.
svg.text: How sprezzature-maps works
Numbers attached to real places, where the shape of the land is part of the answer.
A value per region, point events, or a plate configuration
and the region it is about. The schematic, place-shaped charts, hex map, dot density, spike map, binned grid, stayed
in sprezzature-figures: they plot cells, not coastlines.
Make: three plates on a real base map
Centre the region, then project it
a Lambert conformal conic for a region, chosen rather
than inherited. Every projection distorts something, so the choice
is part of the figure and is written down.
Classify, and name the method on the plate
the same numbers in quantiles and in natural breaks tell two
different stories. A plate that does not say which one it used
is not readable, only decorative.
Draw: choropleth, situation map, or density
real national outlines from a bundled Natural Earth base map.
The density plate has no coastline at all: the land appears
because events fell on it, and the sea stays dark because none
did.
An SVG, with a scale bar in two units at once
kilometres and miles, because a plate is read by people who
think in either
Audit: read the plate back
Six static rules over the rendered plate
a map is read the way a text is, so it is checked the way a text
is
Does it say what it did to the numbers
the classification method, the scale bar, the data credits,
and how sure it is. A map that hides its uncertainty is making
a claim it cannot support.
Findings, exit 1 on any
on a plate this package drew, or on one it did not
A plate a reader can argue with, because it says what it did to the numbers
The rendering primitives are shared with sprezzature-figures rather than copied: the faces embedded in the file so it looks the same
on a machine without them, and the choice between a self-contained SVG and one that links out.
This used to be a set of chart kinds inside sprezzature-figures. It was split out because a map on a real projection is a different product
from a chart, with its own release schedule and its own editor to come.
